The '''Carvandir sector''' was located in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Northern Dependencies" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Neshei sector/Legends|Neshei]] and [[Sarla sector/Legends|Sarla sector]] [[spinward]] and the [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] formed the Expansion Region's boundary with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], neighboring the region's [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor]] and [[Vorc sector/Legends|Vorc sectors]].<ref name="Expansion" /> The Carvandir sector retained those borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] it was situated within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The Carvandir sector contained the [[Carvandir system/Legends|Carvandir system]], which was situated on the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the Deadalis sector's [[Dorin system/Legends|Dorin system]] and the Jalor sector's [[Vaced system/Legends|Vaced system]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked the Carvandir [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Mondress system/Legends|Mondress system]] in the [[Mondress sector/Legends|eponymous sector]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Carvandir sector was established in<ref name="EGtW" /> the [[April 3]], [[2012]]<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/180097/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-star-wars-by-jason-fry-with-paul-r-urquhart/9780345477620|text=The Essential Guide to Warfare: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> On [[October 26]] of the same year, the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," a feature of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> which placed it in grid squares J-7 and J-8.<ref name="Expansion" />
